question: Genome-wide GSEA (as Ruslan's clusterProfiler GSEA, but phylogenetic): which pathways shift with adult mass in mammalian fibroblasts, and which shift the same way in all three panels?
gene_universe: step-1 fixed composition per panel (common_rm.load + background)
ranking: per gene PGLS t of z-scored log expression on log10 adult mass with the panel covariance
set_size: 15 to 500 genes present in the panel universe
ES: weighted running-sum enrichment score (weight |t|, exponent 1), as GSEA/fgsea
null: 1000 phylogenetically simulated log10 mass vectors per panel (MVN with panel covariance, rescaled to observed mean and SD); gene t and ES recomputed, so gene-gene correlation is preserved
NES_p: NES = ES / mean |null ES| of the same sign; p = share of same-sign null ES at least as extreme (+1 correction); BH within panel over all catalogues
concordance: set counted as concordant if NES has the same sign and nominal p < 0.05 in all three panels; also reported for at least two panels
concordance_null: the same 1000 simulated draws give a null count of concordant sets (each simulated ES scored against the remaining null draws); empirical p of the observed counts
combined: Stouffer of signed z from the three panel p values per set, BH over sets; descriptive companion
